## HIGH-priority finding details

### H-1: Gap-fill trigger returns `501`, not `503`, when its secret is unset  (1/3 runs)
- **Docs**: `reference/admin-ui.mdx` said `/trigger/gap-fill` "Returns `503` when the secret is unset (trigger disabled)".
- **Source**: `ai-implement/src/gap-fill-trigger.ts:57-58` — an unset `GAP_FILL_TRIGGER_SECRET` returns `501` with `Gap fill trigger not configured`. `reference/error-codes.mdx` already states `501`, so the pages contradicted each other.
- **Edit**: Changed `503` to `501` in the webhook and trigger endpoints table — from run-3 (sole candidate).
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH in the one run that surfaced it; runs 1 and 2 did not flag it.

## MEDIUM-priority finding details

### M-1: Runner callback endpoints' `501` and body-read `400` errors missing from error-codes tables  (1/3 runs)
- **Docs**: `reference/error-codes.mdx` lists the `/runner/result`, `/runner/progress` and `/runner/planning-context` errors without the `501` returned when `RUNNER_TOKEN_SECRET` is unset, or the `400` responses (`Failed to read body`, `Invalid JSON`).
- **Source**: `ai-implement/src/index.ts:2972-2985`, `:3026-3032`, `:3058-3077`.

### M-2: Webhook `503` missing from the webhook error table  (1/3 runs)
- **Docs**: The `POST /api/github/webhook` table in `reference/error-codes.mdx` lists `400` and `401` only.
- **Source**: `ai-implement/src/index.ts:2955-2959` — returns `503` when `GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is unset.

## LOW-priority findings (aggregate, numbered as L-1, L-2, ...)

- **L-1** — `claude-implement.yml` header lists "Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests" as required while docs correctly say it is not; stale source comment, no docs edit (`ai-implement/workflows/claude-implement.yml:13-14`) (2/3 runs)
- **L-2** — Marketplace catalog in the skills checkout pins `ref: v1.0.0` (`skills-source/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json:13`) versus `skills/installation.mdx:68`; needs maintainer check of the default-branch catalog (1/3 runs)
- **L-3** — `runAutoMerges` has no non-test caller, consistent with docs' unused `autoMerge` (`ai-implement/src/auto-merge.ts:36-39`) (1/3 runs)
